location.display_name: Área Metropolitana de San José, San José, Costa Rica

itinerary.overview: Explore the rich food culture of Costa Rica in San José and surrounding locations over 3 days, including visits to local family in Escazu, San Jose, Palmares, and Santa Ana, plus a trip to La Fortuna for volcano and nature experience, and a beach visit.
itinerary.travel_notes: Costa Rica offers a mix of vibrant culinary scenes and stunning natural attractions. Your itinerary balances food exploration with cultural and family visits, along with outdoor experiences including volcano trips and beach relaxation. Budget allows for a comfortable and varied experience with local dining and excursions.

daily_plan.title: Arrival, Family Visit in Escazu and San José Food Introduction
activities: Arrive in San José and settle into your accommodation.
Visit family in Escazu to connect and experience local life.
Explore Parque Central de San José for a leisurely walk and local atmosphere.
Dine at La Terraza restaurant in San José to experience authentic Costa Rican dishes.

daily_plan.title: La Fortuna Volcano and Food Exploration
activities: Travel to La Fortuna, home to the Arenal Volcano.
Visit Parque de La Fortuna and nearby volcano sights for nature and scenic views.
Lunch at Soda La Parada or Orgánico Fortuna for local cuisine near Fortuna.
Return towards Palmares for family visit or dining.
Dinner in Palmares area at a local restaurant such as Restaurante La Lira.

daily_plan.title: Beach Trip, Family Visits in Santa Ana, and San José Food Finale
activities: Morning beach trip on the Pacific Coast (suggest nearby beach accessible from the Central Valley).
Visit family in Santa Ana and Palmares for local cultural experience and lunch.
Return to San José for a final local food experience with coffee at Tostador and dinner at Vishnu restaurant.
Spare time for souvenirs or local shopping before departure.
